title: An in-place error
summary: Which line makes backward fail, and why.

choices.text: Sigmoid saved its output `y` for its backward, and line B changed `y` in place.
`x` is a leaf that requires grad, and leaves can never be used in in-place operations.
`sum()` cannot follow an in-place operation; it needs a fresh tensor.
`mul_` has no backward formula, so autograd cannot differentiate through line B.
